acceptanceCriteria: A proposed spec (extending AFU-V1 / DCP-V1) defines the screen graph, node/edge records, revision pinning and STALE rules, import-graph test join, projections with byte caps, scaffold and overlay seam, with numbered requirements, non-goals, failure modes and rollback.

Compiling a fixture app with router definitions, flow steps and a Playwright suite yields deterministic screen nodes keyed by app plus route template with resolved hierarchy; ambiguous or unresolved routes are reported as unknown, never guessed.
A spec that reaches a screen by clicking (no goto) is attributed to that screen through the import graph; an anchor whose content changed since the pinned revision reads STALE.
map_screen, map_flow, map_find and map_scaffold return results under their byte caps with omitted counts and an explicit full escape; no projection is unbounded.
map_scaffold drafts a spec skeleton with imports resolved against the fixture test repository and the closest asserting spec cited.
body: Owner request https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/657 (2026-10-07). Agents writing E2E tests for a large web app spend much of each session working out how to reach and drive a screen, although the facts exist across corpus navigation research (one MCP navigation search returned 135283 characters), router state definitions, the Playwright suite (page objects, workflows, scenarios, specs that click through from home), legacy visit URLs and learned run facts (issue 655). An adopter-side compiler joins these heuristically into per-screen cards (1.6 KB) and scaffolds (3.5 KB) with no revision binding. Ask: (1) a screen graph compiled from router definitions with real hierarchy resolution; edges from flow steps and test sequences; each node aggregates permissions, flags, data preconditions, page objects/methods, workflows, scenarios, steps with selector strength and source/test anchors, every element pinned to its read revision and STALE when an anchor changed; (2) test-suite join by import graph (spec -> page object -> screen), not URL; (3) capped projections map_screen/map_flow/map_find/map_scaffold with byte budgets and a --full escape; (4) scaffold from the graph and the closest asserting spec with imports resolved against the real test repository; (5) learned overlay attachment point for run-verified steps (issue 658) and know-how notes (issue 655). Extends AFU-V1 navigation and DCP-V1 corpus; never raises candidate research to behavioural truth.
